overview.overview:
Maine is projected to vote Democratic in 2028, with an expected margin of about 12 points and a plausible range from roughly 3 to 21 points. The state backed Democrats in 2020, when Biden won it by about 9 points, and again in 2024, when Harris won by about 7 points. Maine leans roughly 7.5 points more Democratic than the nation as a whole.

The estimate rests mainly on this voting history and a national environment set about 4.5 points in Democrats' favor. No state-specific polling or home-state candidate adjustment is reflected here. Projected 2026 statewide margins for the Senate and governor races also lean Democratic.
overview.watch: A sharp shift in the national environment or strong state-level polling showing a much closer race would be the most likely sources of change.
key_factors: Democratic wins in 2020 and 2024 by margins of about 7 to 9 points
A lean roughly 7.5 points more Democratic than the national baseline
A national environment estimated at about 4.5 points in Democrats' favor
